name: Modular Arithmetic Obfuscation
description: Replaces a simple inequality constraint ($x \neq y$) with an equivalent modular arithmetic condition ($x + 2y \not\equiv 0 \pmod 3$) over a restricted domain. This breaks pattern matching for graph coloring and forces models to evaluate the constraint algebraically, often bypassing their optimized graph-specific heuristics like degree-based ordering.
